subject: Demo recap & proposed POC plan — FinServCorp
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap & proposed POC plan — FinServCorp

Hi Alex —

Great to meet you and the team on today's demo. Quick recap and a proposed POC plan so we have clear success criteria and ownership.

Demo recap (high level):
- Showed Redwood Hosted API + Dedicated options for low-latency inference.
- Walked through a sample workflow: ingestion -> prompt templates -> streaming responses with function calling for structured outputs.
- Highlighted caching, batching, and quantization recommendations to control cost.

Proposed POC objectives / success criteria (please confirm):
1) Accuracy: Redwood-generated answers match internal policy lookup and retrieval baseline for 80%+ pass rate on the 200-case test set you shared.
2) Latency: 95th percentile API response time under 450ms for our 512-token typical case.
3) Cost: Per-inference cost below $0.015 (token+infra) at projected 10k monthly calls with caching.
4) Integration: Demo a working end-to-end pipeline (S3 ingest -> Redwood API -> downstream service) with sanitized test data.

Proposed timeline & ownership:
- Week 1 (Mar 8–12): Kickoff, access & test data exchange (owner: Alex + FinServ eng).
- Week 2 (Mar 15–19): Integration and baseline runs (owner: FinServ eng, support: Dylan/Marissa).
- Week 3 (Mar 22–26): Evaluation against success criteria, perf tuning (owner: Redwood infra team: Laura + Dylan).
- Week 4 (Mar 29–Apr 2): Wrap, lessons learned, and next steps (commercial/scale discussion).

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Can you confirm the success criteria above or add/adjust?
- Please share sanitized test data or a representative subset (S3 link or secure transfer) by Mar 9 so we can begin.
- We'll attach a short POC outline and mutual action plan for signatures.

Attachments: redwood-poc-outline.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx (stubs attached).

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finservcorp.com>

Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed POC plan — FinServCorp

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the recap and the clear plan. A few notes/questions from our side:

1) Success criteria — mostly aligned. A couple of clarifications: 
   - For Accuracy: we'll run both a retrieval-augmented and a closed-book comparison. Can you confirm Redwood can import our vector index snapshot for fair comparison?
   - For Latency: 450ms p95 sounds good but we need a test harness that mirrors our spike patterns (short bursts at start-of-day).

2) Data & access — security/PII: Our security team needs to confirm that test data can be injected into a sandboxed environment. Do you have a standard data handling checklist or SOC2 artifacts we can share with them?

3) Timeline — the dates look good, but legal may ask for a slightly later start (week of Mar 15). Our engineering manager (Gail) is on copy and will coordinate access.

4) Owners — I'll own the integration on our side; Gail will own contract/SOW. We'll add our ML lead to the thread once legal gives the green light.

Can you also confirm whether Redwood will provide a lightweight ingest spec (file format, auth flow) and a sample test harness we can run locally?

Appreciate it — will aim to share the sanitized subset by Mar 9 if possible.

Best,
Alex Turner
Sr. Product Manager — Data & Automation
FinServCorp
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Gail Simmons <gail.simmons@finservcorp.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed POC plan — FinServCorp

Thanks Alex — all good notes. Answers below and updated plan attached.

1) Vector index import: yes — we can import a static snapshot of your vectors into a sandbox index. We'll sanitize and store only embeddings metadata; full doc content can remain in your S3 if you'd prefer. We'll share the import steps in the ingest spec.

2) Latency & test harness: we'll provide a simple load generator (node/python script) that reproduces burst patterns. We'll also run a small-scale hosted run to validate p95 under your spike profile.

3) Security artifacts: attaching our brief data handling checklist and we've shared our SOC 2 Type II summary via secure drive link. If your team needs an NDA or an MSA prior to exchange, flag it and we'll loop legal.

4) Ingest spec & sample harness: attached: sample-ingest-spec.json and a link to the repo with the harness. The harness supports S3-based test data and a local mode for quick validations.

Updated timeline (to match potential Mar 15 start):
- Week 0 (ASAP): Legal & access approvals (owner: Gail + Redwood legal).
- Week 1 (Mar 15–19): Kickoff + data transfer + baseline runs (owner: Alex + FinServ eng).
- Week 2 (Mar 22–26): Integration & tuning (owner: FinServ eng + Laura).
- Week 3 (Mar 29–Apr 2): Evaluation & wrap (owner: Laura + Dylan).

Attachments: sample-ingest-spec.json, redwood-poc-outline.pdf (updated), mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Related links:
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/FS-2026-042
- Drive folder (SOC2 & artifacts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/finserv-poc

Next steps I suggest:
- Gail to confirm legal path and whether we need an NDA before test data.
- Alex to share sanitized subset or permit S3 access by Mar 9 (if possible).
- We'll schedule a kickoff calendar invite for the week of Mar 15 once legal confirms.

If that all sounds good I'll coordinate internally to reserve a Dedicated sandbox cluster for the runs.

Thanks — talk soon.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
